reviews.text:
Well-kept place.
Personalized. Prepared
A place created with care and love for four-legged friends. A top experience. We'll be back.
A super welcoming and safe place for our four-legged friends. Incredibly professional and kind! I noticed the change in my dog ​​after just a couple of lessons. I highly recommend the place.
A dog boarding/training center that rejects Pitbulls or similar crosses, I'm shocked. Obviously without even having seen and evaluated my dog ​​in this case. Bah.

Van Dog has been absolutely amazing for my Swiss shepherd and I in Rome! Moving here, it was a challenge to find a boarding facility that worked for me. Van Dog has made my life so much easier and they have been taking incredible care of my senior dog. They are also bilingual which is helpful as I am still learning Italian. They have an extensive induction process that I appreciate and have taken care of my Leah for short and longer stays. The premise is absolutely beautiful and a short drive from the city. I feel a peace of mind as they provide regular updates and ensure she gets the right food, medication, and play time. Really happy with this service and my Leah celebrated her 13th birthday with them - they even sent me these wonderful photos!

A fantastic discovery for my two wild dogs! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
Ermes and Ade, my two Lagottos, are two real furies, full of energy and always ready to get up to mischief! Especially Ade, the youngest, is a true anarchist who doesn't want to know anything about rules.
My groomer recommended this center, and I have to say it was one of the best choices I could have made! Thanks to the skill and patience of Matteo and his entire team (Alice, Michela, and Federico), my two wild dogs have transformed: now they are well-behaved, manageable, and I can take them anywhere without stress or embarrassment.
The behavior lessons were wonderful and truly effective. Now we're about to start the play sessions, which I can't wait to try!
But the part I love most? The daycare! The place is impeccable: clean, meticulously cared for, and you can see the passion in everything they do. When I take Ermes and Ade there, they're so happy, and when I pick them up, they're so tired and calm that they literally disappear for the rest of the day!
I've found the only place and the only people I'd trust with my dogs if I were to be away. Matteo and his staff aren't just professional, they're special people who know how to instill a sense of security for both our furry friends and us owners.
100% highly recommended! If you have a lively dog ​​(or an anarchic one like my Ade), this is the place. Thank you so much, guys!
